description: Gares, stations et pôles d'échanges multimodaux en projet en Île-de-France is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Couche géographique recensant les arrêts et pôles d'échanges multimodaux des tracés des projets de transport en commun en Île-de-France. Un arrêt est un lieu de montée ou descente d'une ligne de transport en projet. Un pôle d’échanges multimodal est un lieu d’interface entre le mode ferroviaire et les autres modes de déplacement. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Déplacements - transports. Its keywords are Transports en commun, Géolocalisation, Métro, Gare, RER, Train. The portal shows 301 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-08-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
